goal_name: Ensure access control to information systems

subgoals.objective_name: To ensure authorized and controlled access to information systems and resources.
subgoals.goal_name: Ensure authorized and controlled access to information systems and resources

subgoals.control_name: Develop, document, and disseminate policy and procedures to facilitate the implementation of access control controls.

subgoals.goal_name: Develop policy and procedures to facilitate the implementation of access control controls
subgoals.embedding_context: Develop policy and procedures to facilitate the implementation of access control controls

actions.name: Access Policy Administration
actions.description: Access policy administration is the systematic process of defining, implementing, and managing access control policies that dictate user permissions to resources.

actions.name: Access Mediation
actions.description: Access mediation is the process of granting or denying specific requests to: 1) obtain and use information and related information processing services; and 2) enter specific physical facilities (e.g., Federal buildings, military establishments, border crossing entrances). Access mediation decisions should enforce least privilege by granting access for scoped durations to prevent privilege creep and, where applicable, implement just-in-time (JIT) access. Denial decisions may prevent initial access or terminate access that has already been granted, ensuring continuous enforcement of security policies.

actions.name: Access Modeling
actions.description: Access modeling captures and records the access permissions granted to identities (e.g., administrators, users, groups, systems) and optionally includes details on how these identities are stored, managed, and shared across systems.

actions.name: Network Resource Access Mediation
actions.description: Control of access to organizational systems and services by users or processes over a network.

actions.name: Physical Access Mediation
actions.description: Physical access mediation is the process of granting or denying specific requests to enter specific physical facilities (e.g., Federal buildings, military establishments, border crossing entrances.)

actions.name: Permissions Control
actions.description: Limit permissions to the minimum required.

actions.name: Data Access Control
actions.description: Limit external data source access.

actions.name: Principle of least privilege
actions.description: Implement robust access control mechanisms, enforce the principle of least privilege, and regularly update and patch systems to close security gaps that could be exploited for privilege escalation.

actions.name: Privilege Control
actions.description: Limit LLM access and apply role-based permissions.

actions.name: Human Approval
actions.description: Require user consent for privileged actions.
